name: chicken_loop
desc: the egg economy at your pen (or chickens near you): feed two hens seeds so a chick is born (5 min cooldown, pen kept at 4-6), pick up eggs, throw some at the chickens (about 1 egg in 8 hatches), take meat when the pen is big enough, cook it. Needs 2 seeds or eggs; daylight. Result lists each part honestly

cooldown.text: no chickens to work with, no seeds, or nothing to do yet (hens lay one egg per 5-10 min, parents rest 5 min after breeding)
cooldown.hint: seed_hunt gets seeds; animal_pen fences chickens in; come back in a few minutes
